get.description:
Reports whether the API is running and connected to NATS.

Responds with 503 while NATS is unreachable, so container health checks notice it.

delete.description:
Deletes all of the owner's data: cameras, watchlists, targets, images, alerts and evidence.

Deleting an owner that has no data succeeds too, so the call can be repeated safely.

get.description: Lists the owner's alerts of both kinds, or of one, newest first.
Lists the owner's identity match alerts, newest first.
Lists the owner's rule alerts, newest first.
Counts the owner's alerts by kind and review state, and by UTC day.
Returns one of the owner's alerts.

post.description: Marks the alert as seen, without a verdict.
Records the reviewer's verdict, which also acknowledges the alert.

get.description:
Returns the frame the alert was raised on.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: The alert has no snapshot, or retention already removed it.
Lists the owner's cameras, oldest first.

schema.title: Response List Cameras Owners  Owner Id  Cameras Get

post.description: Adds a camera for the owner.

delete.description: Deletes the camera with its zones and rules; its alerts stay.

get.description: Returns one of the owner's cameras.

patch.description: Changes the given fields; a running camera restarts unless only its metadata changed.

get.description: Returns the camera's latest frame as a JPEG.
Relays an HLS playlist or segment that the camera's playlist links to.
Returns the HLS playlist, whose relative links lead to the ``hls`` files below.

post.description:
Answers a WebRTC offer; the media then flows directly between go2rtc and the viewer.

The viewer must reach go2rtc's WebRTC port, since only the negotiation passes through the API.

get.description: Lists the rules of the owner's camera: zone occupancy rules first, then line rules.

patch.description:
Changes the given fields of the rule.

Raises:
    InvalidEntityError: A field does not apply to the rule's kind.

post.description:
Asks the camera manager to run the camera.

Raises:
    InvalidEntityError: The camera is disabled.
Asks the camera manager to stop the camera.

get.description: Lists the zones of the owner's camera.

patch.description: Changes the given fields; cameras apply new thresholds without restarting.

post.description:
Creates a batch of targets with their reference images and queues them for enrollment.

Every uploaded file must be named by exactly one target. Nothing is stored unless the whole
batch is valid.

Raises:
    InvalidEntityError: The specifications or files are invalid.
